items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Manny Albam had a funny anecdote about, I think he was producing the Guess Who.

ctx.x: when there was 35 people sitting out there and the tape machine would break right before the session, and we’d have to sit there for an hour. You’re looking at your watch and they’re looking at their watches. Because they know they’re only there for three hours; maybe two sessions, six hours. And you’ve got to get it. And the tape machine broke one time and we wasted an hour while they fixed that. The studio is not going to pay for those musicians. But we had to cram into two hours what we would have done in…
Yeah. I had a funny, Manny Albam had a funny anecdote about, I think he was producing the Guess Who.
